plainTranslation: Their Saturn in your 5th house: they bring seriousness to your fun and romance - commitment, or a wet blanket on your playfulness. Failure mode: they make romance feel like work, or judge your self-expression. Let them steady the bond; protect your joy and creativity.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry house overlay material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
